text:
maya: Heads up 3 running into a flaky Cloudflare Worker build when our sample-app consumes the JS SDK from a pnpm workspace. Deploy error: `Could not resolve '@our-sdk' -> tried '/workspace/node_modules/.pnpm/..../@our-sdk'` which isn't present in the artifact. Works when I `npm install` locally. Anyone seen pnpm virtual store + edge bundlers?

oli: That matches pnpm's symlink/virtual-store layout leaking into the bundle. Which bundler+packager? wrangler + esbuild?

maya: yes, wrangler 3 + esbuild + node-resolve plugin. The resolver sometimes follows conditional `exports` and ends up pointing at the pnpm store path.

samir: Two pragmatic fixes: 1) consumer CI: set `nodeLinker=node-modules` so pnpm writes a classic node_modules (no virtual store), or 2) SDK-side: publish a tiny root ESM shim and simplify `exports` so bundlers have a single entry to follow.

linh: Also ensure `./package.json` is listed in `exports` to avoid tools reading package.json from the store. And include top-level `types` since some tooling doesn't read `types` only inside `exports`.

maya: here's the original fragment we shipped: ```json
"exports": {".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs.js"},"./feature":"./dist/esm/feature.mjs"}
```

maya: esbuild ends up resolving `@our-sdk/feature` into the virtual store path during bundle time.

oli: SDK pattern that helped us: add `index.mjs` at package root with `export * from './dist/esm/index.mjs'`, then set `"exports":{".":{"import":"./index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs.js"},"./package.json":"./package.json"}` and keep top-level `types":"dist/index.d.ts"`. That flattens runtime resolution.

samir: For CI detection, add a sample-app test that simulates a deploy build: in a pnpm workspace, `pnpm pack` the SDK, then `npm i ./sdk-x.y.z.tgz` inside the app and run the worker bundle step. That reproduces the missing-store-file failure without forcing nodeLinker changes.

linh: Also mention `preserveSymlinks` toggles for bundlers; some resolvers can be configured to not resolve symlinks which avoids chasing store paths. But that's not reliable across edge platforms.

maya: We implemented the SDK shim change + ensured d.ts files are packaged. After that, Cloudflare bundles succeed even when the app consumes the SDK via workspace symlink. We still keep the CI recommendation for `nodeLinker=node-modules` as a fallback.

oli: Good. Please add a short DevEx note: "pnpm workspaces + edge bundlers: prefer SDK root ESM shim + simple exports; fallback: nodeLinker=node-modules or pack+install during CI." Include the esbuild reproduction command snippet.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-342: "pnpm virtual store paths breaking edge bundles; add sample-app CI reproducer + SDK shim" :spiral_note_pad:

maya: I'll open the PR with the shim + sample-app CI job and tag @samir. Thanks! :rocket:
